# Pathways - AUCell

In this section we use AUCell to calculate pathway activity across thousands of pathways. We use pathways found in the Reactome database for this analysis.

```{r}
#| label: loading preamble
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
source("./preamble.R")
```

AUCell operates independently on cells and on pathways, so we use chunking of our dataset to run all these calculations.

```{r}
#| label: run_aucell
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: true
#| eval: false

# Read in gene sets and chunk for processing
# original location: gene.sets <- readRDS("~/data/dan/imputation_smoothing/breast_reanalysis/gene.sets.list.rds")[["human"]]
gene.sets <- readRDS(paste0(pathway_dir, "/Data/gene.sets.list.rds"))[["human"]]
chunks <- data.table(strt=unique(c(seq(1, length(gene.sets), 100), length(gene.sets))))
chunks[,stp:=data.table::shift(strt, 1, type="lead")]
chunks <- chunks[-c(.N)]
chunks[1:(.N-1),stp:=stp-1]

# if there's no seurat object, read it in
if (!("seu.obj" %in% ls())){
  seu.obj <- readRDS(results_list$seurat_file_postCellTyping)
}

# Extract normalized data and meta data
tc <- Matrix::colSums(seu.obj[["RNA"]]@counts)
scale.factor <- mean(tc)
normed <- seu.obj[["RNA"]]@counts %*% Matrix::Diagonal(x = scale.factor / tc, names = TRUE)
met <- data.table(seu.obj@meta.data)

# Calculate median diversity percentile
median_diversity_pctile <- median(met$nFeature_RNA) / nrow(normed)


##############################################################################
## Run AUCell by chunks of cells
##############################################################################

cells <- met[["cell_ID"]]
cellchunks <- data.table(cells)[,chunk:=floor((1:.N)/20000) + 1][]
for(ii in 1:cellchunks[,max(chunk)]){

  message(ii)
  cellsscore <- cellchunks[chunk==ii][["cells"]]
  chunk_counts <- normed[,cellsscore]
  set.seed(250404)
  cells_rankings <- AUCell::AUCell_buildRankings(exprMat=as(chunk_counts, "dgCMatrix"), 
                                                 ,plotStats = FALSE
                                                 ,splitByBlocks = TRUE
                                                 ,BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 3)
                                                 
  )
  
  saveRDS(cells_rankings, paste0(pathway_dir, "/Data/cells_ranking_cellchunk_", ii, ".rds"))
  
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(chunks), style=3) 
  for(chunky in 1:nrow(chunks)){

    message(chunky)
    strt <- chunks[chunky,strt]
    stp <- chunks[chunky,stp]
    #run aucell for all gene sets 
    reschunk <- AUCell::AUCell_calcAUC(geneSets=gene.sets[strt:stp], cells_rankings, 
                                       aucMaxRank=ceiling(nrow(cells_rankings)*median_diversity_pctile), verbose = TRUE,
                                       nCores = 4,
                                      
    )
    reschunk <- as(reschunk@assays@data$AUC, "sparseMatrix")
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, chunky)
    saveRDS(reschunk, file=paste0(pathway_dir, "/Data/cellsAUC_"
                                  ,".cellschunk__",ii
                                  ,".chunk__",chunky
                                  ,".rds")
            )
    
    rm(reschunk); gc()
  } 
  gc()
    
}

# Join all cells and pathways to one matrix
cells_auc_full <- NULL
for(ii in 1:cellchunks[,max(chunk)]){
  
  cells_auc_mtx <- readRDS(file=paste0(pathway_dir, "/Data/cellsAUC_"
                                       ,".cellschunk__",ii
                                       ,".chunk__","1"
                                       ,".rds"))
  
  for(chunky in 2:nrow(chunks)){
    
    temp_mtx <- readRDS(file=paste0(pathway_dir, "/Data/cellsAUC_"
                                    ,".cellschunk__",ii
                                    ,".chunk__",chunky
                                    ,".rds"))
    cells_auc_mtx <- rbind(cells_auc_mtx, temp_mtx)
  }
  
  if(is.null(cells_auc_full)){
    cells_auc_full <- cells_auc_mtx
  } else{
    cells_auc_full <- cbind(cells_auc_full, cells_auc_mtx)
  }
}

saveRDS(cells_auc_full, file = paste0(pathway_dir, "/Data/cellsAUC_"
                                      ,"full"
                                      ,".rds"))
```

Make a heatmap of the top pathways by tumor subtype.
```{r}
#| label: plot_tumors_topPathways
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: true
#| eval: false

# if there's no seurat object, read it in
if (!("seu.obj" %in% ls())){
  seu.obj <- readRDS(results_list$seurat_file_postCellTyping)
}
met = as.data.table(seu.obj@meta.data)

# Read in cells x pathways score matrix, pathway data (pwd)
pwd <- readRDS(file = paste0(pathway_dir, "/Data/cellsAUC_"
                                      ,"full"
                                      ,".rds"))

## Heatmap of top differentiating pathways by tumor type
tum_cells <- seu.obj$cell_id[grep("tumor", seu.obj$minor_cell_type)]

pwfctbl_tum <- 
        smiSmooth::clusterwise_foldchange_metrics(normed = pwd[,tum_cells]
                                     ,metadata = met[cell_ID %in% tum_cells,.(minor_cell_type, cell_ID)]
                                     ,cluster_column = "minor_cell_type")
# Save it
saveRDS(pwfctbl_tum, file = paste0(pathway_dir, "/Data/pwfctbl_tum.rds"))

# Change pathway names
pwfctbl_tum$gene <- gsub("REACTOME_", "", pwfctbl_tum$gene)

# Make a heatmap showing top differentiating pathway by cell type
png(filename = paste0(pathway_dir, "/Plots/heatmap_pathways_by_cell_type_tumors.png"),
    height = 6, width = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
smiSmooth::marker_heatmap(pwfctbl_tum, topn=5) + coord_flip()
dev.off()

```

Heatmap of top pathways by tumor subtype:

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(pathway_dir, "/Plots/heatmap_pathways_by_cell_type_tumors.png"))
